label: preparing
what: A secret surprise jubilee for the mayor, at eighteen on day 1 in the great/town hall: replacing mouldy feast bread with 200 fresh loaves, fifty on each of four tables, installing eight lanterns, and arranging the innkeeper to escort the mayor under the cover of an inn-service meeting. No additional knowing helpers are established: secretary arranged the cover appointment and later heard some revealing remarks, but the record does not show knowingly assisting the surprise; neighbour's tea was ordinary.
